caption: This drawing features a single wooden spoon oriented vertically in the center of the composition, depicted against a plain, light beige background. The spoon has a cylindrical handle that is light brown with visible wood grain texture and is slightly darker at the top. At the upper end, there is a loop of string or cord passing through a hole in the handle, with two small tassels hanging from the ends of the loop. About a quarter of the way down from the top, a segment of the handle is wrapped tightly with dark, coiled string or cord. The spoon's bowl is rounded with flat edges and displays marks and lines indicating wood grain and possible age or use, matching the color and texture of the handle. No other objects or design elements are present in the drawing.
title: Baker's Mixing Spoon
